content: The Chi Square Calculator is a tool designed to perform chi-square calculations using a 2x2 contingency table. To utilize this calculator, follow these steps: 1. Access the provided link to download the spreadsheet file. 2. Within the spreadsheet, locate the white input boxes. Enter the numerical values corresponding to the number of individuals in each group into these boxes. 3. Optionally, you may also input the specific names of the groups (which correspond to the rows) and the categories (which correspond to the columns) to better organize and label your data.
